channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 11
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 11 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Potrero Power Station Block 11 now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Potrero Power Station Block 11 now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4232021.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Block 11's mapping notes now cite the final Design for Development (Feb 26, 2020, Figure 6.2.3 and Table 3.1.1) instead of a dead 2019 draft link. An unsourced '85-145 ft range' and a Keyser Marston / '~500,000 GSF' comparison were removed, the architect statement was corrected (the Meyers+ page and the June 2020 pre-application slides do list Herzog & de Meuron + Adamson for Blocks 11, 12 and 15), and the Power Station Park statement was corrected (the strip next to Block 15 is Louisiana Paseo). The 430,000 sq ft figure is now described as office, per the project's engineer, not a life-science campus. The caveat no longer says no Assessor parcel exists: an active unaddressed lot (4232021) overlaps most of the footprint but is not confirmed as this block's parcel. The 2028 completion is kept as a soft 2020 Phase 1 forecast, the July 2026 height request is no longer marked as expected, and a Chronicle title, D4D publisher, Meyers+ date and one image kind were corrected.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Developer requests a Development Agreement amendment increasing Block 11's permitted height by 15 feet, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants; the Planning Commission considered the request (Chronicle, July 29, 2026), and if it agrees the amendment goes to the Board of Supervisors (~2026)

Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Phase 1 completion forecast: Block 11 is part of Phase 1 (per the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list, Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), which SocketSite's October 2020 report of the revised phasing said would be completed in 2028; a 2020 forecast, not a current Block 11 date (~2028)

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 11 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date. (Block 11 was later named one of Phase 1's six blocks by the October 2020 Phase 1 Development Phase Application -- a construction-phase assignment, not when it first entered the plan.) (Apr 21, 2020)
